'''Arne Thomas''' (born 1975) is a German [[chemist]] who researches [[Porous medium|porous]] and [[Nanomaterials|nanostructured]] materials for [[Catalysis|catalytic]] applications.

==Career==
Thomas studied chemistry at the [[University of Giessen]], the [[University of Marburg]], and at the [[Heriot-Watt University]]. He conducted his doctoral research under the direction of Markus Antonietti at the [[Max Planck Institute of Colloids and Interfaces]] and defended his [[PhD]] thesis in 2004.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://d-nb.info/970609892|title=Poröse Silikate durch Nanocasting: von chiralen Templaten zu neuer Chemie in Poren|publisher=German National Library|accessdate=2022-04-15}}</ref> In 2005, following a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoc]] position at [[Galen D. Stucky]]'s lab at the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]], he returned to the Max Planck Institute of Colloids and Interfaces as a group leader.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://falling-walls.com/people/arne-thomas/|title=Falling Walls People: Arne Thomas|publisher=Falling Walls Foundation|accessdate=2022-04-15}}</ref> Since 2009, he has been [[full professor]] for [[inorganic chemistry]] (Functional Materials) at [[Technische Universität Berlin]]. Since 2019 he is the spokesperson of the Cluster of Excellence [[Unifying Systems in Catalysis]] (UniSysCat).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.berlin-university-alliance.de/en/excellence-strategy/clusters/unisyscat/index.html|title=Unifying Systems in Catalysis (UniSysCat)|publisher=Berlin University Alliance|accessdate=2022-04-15}}</ref>

==Awards==
* 2022, 2020, 2019, 2018, and 2017 Clarivate [[Highly Cited Researcher]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://publons.com/researcher/2322831/|title=Arne Thomas |publisher=Clarivate - Web of Science|accessdate=2022-04-14}}</ref>
* 2019 Hollow Materials Young Innovator Award
* 2011 [[European Research Council|ERC]] Starting Grant<ref>{{cite web |url=https://erc.easme-web.eu/?p=278593|title=Organic Zeolites (ORGZEO) |publisher=European Commission|accessdate=2022-04-14}}</ref>
* 2011 [[Bayer]] Early Excellence in Science Award<ref>{{cite web |url=https://idw-online.de/en/news456934|title=Bayer Early Excellence in Science Award |publisher=Informationsdienst Wissenschaft|accessdate=2022-04-14}}</ref>
* 2004 Georg-Manecke Award (Best PhD Thesis in Polymer Chemistry)
